title: Per Eric E
content: I was alone at home on a sunny spring day and reading a book. I was under severe stress after a shocking financial loss that threatened to force me to sell our house. I have five kids. The book was about meditation and the vibrations in the universe. I thought it was nonsense and put it down. I closed my eyes, feeling the sun warm my cheek. All of a sudden, I left my body and entered another reality, like going to another dimension. Everything was vibration. I felt an extraordinary sense of love. There, I met other beings who welcomed me and radiated immense love. I felt at home. These beings resembled spiritual figures such as sages, monks, and nuns. They were wise and serene. I felt so cared for, that I didn’t want to leave. Then just as suddenly, I was back in my body. I immediately stood up, looking around my own living room. It felt unreal, like an illusion. The place I had just visited, felt perfectly real. This event profoundly changed me. Before, I identified with my ego and intellect. Now, I see my ego as more of an observer. I instantly knew eternal life was real and death an illusion. I entered a state of grace, feeling deeply loved. I no longer just believed in God, but I became a knower. I simply know we have eternal life. A strong sense of connectedness grew inside me. I felt linked to all people in a deep way, seeing myself in others. I needed to help because they were "us." I started giving my time to those in deep need, donating money and love. I felt powerfully guided by unexplainable synchronicities so intricate that I knew God must be behind them. I’m still guided. I feel deeply that what we call death is actually life itself. It is our source, where we come from and return to. I am not my body.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No, Crisis due to a big loss of money, Other (briefly specify), Spontaneous while reading a book
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, I felt totally connected with everything. We spoke through telepathy and feelings. It was very vivid and extremely real.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, Time did not exist.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: There was nothing to see. It was only the perception of other beings; and information exchange in other ways, like feelings and telepathy.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: There was nothing to hear, just a knowing. I can't explain where this knowing is perceived, but it just is.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes, Spiritual people, sages, and other beings like Thai monks and nuns who were able to leave their bodies, just as I have done.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, See my narrative above.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Unconditional love, grace, peace, serenity, joy, and a sense of homecoming.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe, I just know. It is a deep, profound knowing.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Unaffiliated- Agnostic, At the time I was agnostic due to a magical IVF treatment two years prior to my OBE. Before that, I was an atheist.
elements.What is your religion now?: Other or several faiths, Well, I have evolved from being an atheist via agnostic to a believer all the way to knowing. I just know.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, It was a complete 180-degree turnaround of all I thought was real. Life on earth is some kind of illusion or dream.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, There was some sort of communication far beyond words, no language, just a direct knowing.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes, Spiritual people, sages, and other beings like Thai monks and nuns who were able to leave their bodies, just as I have done.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, It exists. The whole universe is alive. Matter is a function of consciousness.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, I just know there is a God.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, We are all connected to each other. We share the same soul. I felt a very strong urge to help my fellow human beings. The meaning of life is to give away as much love as possible, which then multiplies.
Yes, Life is eternal and everywhere.

Yes, I can see my scared little ego from the outside. I still have big problems with my ego. It still gives me angst and stress and other earthly dilemmas. But I no longer identify myself with it. It is some form of ego separation.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: It is as if I have been born again, but this time as a knower. I have a smile on my face because I know.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, Some people think I am too deep, so I have to be careful with whom I share this. Not all are open for this.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, No words can explain this properly.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I will never forget this. It is just not possible. It is in me and everywhere.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, I see signs and guidance in people and animals.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: A profound feeling of being loved and taken care of.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, More real than life here on earth.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, I have had a second OBE. This time I went all the way to a white orb, our source. It is as if I have been primed for more experiences to come. Someone is looking after me and my spiritual journey. I feel guided. It feels so meaningful. Now I want to work with dying people, to help them in the transition to the other side of life.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes, I have had a second OBE, and I feel I am primed for more to come.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Yes. Now I am perfectly happy with a smile of knowing on my face.
